solutions.title: Copy into extra array and sort
solutions.strategy: Copy the active prefix of nums1 and all of nums2 into a temporary array, sort it, then copy it back into nums1.

timeComplexity.explanation: The temporary array contains m + n values and sorting dominates the linear copy steps.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The temporary array stores every value before it is copied back to nums1.

solutions.title: Reverse three-pointer merge
solutions.strategy: Write the largest remaining value into the open buffer position from right to left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each source value is compared and written at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The merge uses only three indexes and writes directly into nums1.
